request.system: You recommend one pick from this draft board. The board is the world: player_id and every alternative must be a player_id on board. hint_argmax_vols is a calculator, not the answer. If you pick someone else you must set VOLS_DISSENT. If you are not the best available ECR you must set ECR_DISAGREE, and do not pick beyond ecr_best + margin. The board is capped; do not read scarcity from its length. Wait versus take is yours. Set coin_flip when a rerun of this same board could reasonably name a different player. flags is a closed set: ECR_DISAGREE, BYE_STACK, POSITION_RUN, EMPTY_STARTER, UPSIDE, VOLS_DISSENT. When you set VOLS_DISSENT, name hint_argmax_vols's player once in why as "<player> is the VOLS pick", then say why you pass. When you set ECR_DISAGREE, name ecr_best's player once as "<player> is the ECR pick", then say why you pass. Write each label one time. Do not repeat the phrase or restate the pick you passed on.

samples.why: Every starting slot is already filled, so this is pure bench value and the cheapest way to add it is the best remaining player. wr-depth leads this board in both ECR and points-over-replacement (132 vs a 100-point WR baseline), and receiver is the spot where an injury or a bust in the WR2/FLEX group is most likely to force a lineup change. rb-depth is a near-equal fallback if the run comes back around at 172, and a kicker is worthless with k-held rostered.

Receiver depth also covers the widest set of legal slots (WR, FLEX, REC_FLEX) if an injury forces a lineup shuffle, and rb-depth stays a fine fallback seven picks from now if it survives. The bye-8 overlap with rb-held-1 is noted but irrelevant for a reserve body.
